en.name: Plank
en.about: A position held on your forearms and toes. It trains your abdominals and back to keep your body still and straight.
steps: Lie face down with your elbows under your shoulders and your forearms and palms flat on the floor.
Straighten your legs, rest on your toes and brace your abdominals so that your whole body is firm.
Lift your body off the floor until it forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Keep your shoulders over your elbows, keep breathing, and hold the position for the set time.
Lower your body to the floor slowly, keeping it firm, then relax.
Stop the hold if you feel pain in your lower back.

mistakes.says: Lower back sags toward the floor. Brace your abdominals and keep your hips in line with your shoulders and heels.
Hips rise too high. Lower them until your body forms a straight line.
Knees bend. Keep your legs straight and firm.
Shoulders shrug toward your ears or move past your elbows. Keep them down and stacked over your elbows.
Breath is held. Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold.

sources.name: American Council on Exercise (ACE), Exercise Library: Front Plank
